name: line_position
description: Retrieve a word at a numbered line from a newline-separated list; matched control retrieves a specified word from the same list without line indexing.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
words=['apple','pear','plum','peach','grape','melon','lime','berry','lemon','mango','cherry','fig']
for i in range(120):
 n=random.randint(3,6); ws=random.sample(words,n); j=random.randrange(n)
 ctx='Read these lines:\n'+'\n'.join(ws)+'\n\n'
 items.append({'prompt':ctx+f'Which word is on line {j+1}? Answer:', 'answer':' '+ws[j]})
 control.append({'prompt':ctx+f'Copy the word "{ws[j]}" from the list. Answer:', 'answer':' '+ws[j]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
